values.note: Summer sites are booked through the Parks Canada Reservation Service (online or 1-877-737-3783); the winter loop is first-come with self-registration. Check-in after 2 pm, check-out before 11 am. Six people, two vehicles and one RV per site. Generators 8-10 am and 5-7 pm.

note: On the Icefields Parkway beside the Athabasca River, 3.8 km south of Jasper townsite; takes most sizes of motorhome and trailer. Running at reduced capacity for summer 2026 after the 2024 Jasper wildfire. --Claude
summary: Keep. Summer May 13 - Oct 28 reservable (150 sites, reduced 2026), then a 40-site electrical winter loop first-come until early May: written as year-round with the detail in season.note. Rates corrected: cheapest site is electrical C$40 (stored C$34 unserviced rate is not a Wapiti site type), top C$53.75.
flags: fees.nightly_low 34 -> 40: the Jasper camping page lists Wapiti's types as 'Electrical with fire pit, Electrical, Unserviced with fire pit'; the C$34 line on the fees page is 'unserviced, no fire pit', which Wapiti does not list. Its unserviced sites are C$47.75.

Season written as year_round: true although the pages leave a gap of about a week in early May between the winter loop closing ('early May, closing date TBD') and the May 13 opening. Owner may prefer opens/closes for the main campground instead; the detail is in season.note either way.
Dump station and RV water: the winter page says neither is available in winter; the summer pages read do not say. facilities.dump left unset.
hookups: water and sewer at the site not stated; left unset.
PIN: no move. Stored 52.83800,-118.06450 falls among the loops between the parkway and the river (imagery z16).
PHONE: stored 1-877-737-3783 is the Parks Canada reservation line, the only number the pages give.

Waterfront: 'not waterfront' stands. Upgrade LEAD, not written: Parks Canada says 'On the shore of the Athabasca River' and its map puts the FF electrical loop nearest the river; on imagery (z16, rendered) the eastern loops' sites run about 40-80 m from the bank through thin, partly burned forest. Not confirmed at site level.

Agency rows: the entry inherits the generic `federal` row's booking platform (recreation.gov), 180-day window and the US interagency senior/access discount; none applies to Parks Canada.
